overall.summary: Practice Fusion EHR provides a broad vendor-native TSV export surface with strong field-level documentation across core clinical and administrative EHI domains. The export appears migration-usable, but downstream reconstruction still depends on inferred relationships, incomplete value-set documentation, and boundary assumptions around full claims/payment operations and some external product data.

notableFacts: The current public EHI documentation snapshot is v9 (published January 12, 2026) and follows a recurring v1-v9 release cadence.
The vendor documents manual export for both a single patient and an entire practice population.
The exported model is documented as 85 TSV entities with 1,165 typed fields in the downloaded v9 dictionary artifact.
Clinical plus insurance/superbill/lab/message/referral domains are all explicitly represented in the table inventory.
No vendor-published machine-readable schema, explicit FK map, full value-set catalog, or sample TSV payload files were found in the downloaded artifacts.
